newsitem.title: UK: UK firms capital expenditure up 1.0% in Q3.
newsitem.headline: UK firms capital expenditure up 1.0% in Q3.

text.p: UK manufacturers' spending on capital assets, including leased assets, rose by a provisional seasonally adjusted one pct in the third quarter of 1996 over the second quarter, Office for National Statistics data showed.
Manufacturers' expenditure totalled 2.809 billion stg in the third quarter after 2.781 billion in the second quarter.
But expenditure was 14 pct lower than in the third quarter of 1995, when it totalled 3.249 billion stg.

The provisional estimates of capital expenditure for other production rose by six percent, while services were up by one percent but construction fell 27 percent over the previous quarter, the ONS said.
Other production rose by three percent, services by two percent and construction fell by 21 percent over the third quarter of 1995.
